suggested_solution: ["Cooling Solution: Invest in a high-quality cooling pad with multiple fans, such as the IIano V12", "Fan Cleaning: Regularly clean the laptop fans and vents with a duster to ensure proper airflow", "Power Management: Enable Silent Mode (blue light on power button) when gaming to limit voltage and reduce heat", "Surface Usage: Use a hard flat surface for gaming to improve airflow and reduce heat buildup", "Lap Desk or Cooling Pad: Consider using a lap desk or cooling pad under the laptop to maintain a safe temperature", "Monitoring Temperatures: Regularly check CPU temperatures (cap at 80\u00b0C) and adjust settings as needed"]
